title: Formal Related-Key Security of AES
summary: A formal AES security proof against differential and linear cryptanalysis in the related-key model remains to be established.

formal_statement.body: A stated future task for AES is to establish a formal security proof against both differential and linear cryptanalysis in the related-key model, thereby resolving the lack of such a proof identified for this setting.

scope.domain: Formal security analysis of AES against differential and linear cryptanalysis.
assumptions: Security is considered in the related-key model.
parameters: Differential and linear cryptanalysis — attack classes covered by the sought proof
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish the requested formal security proof for AES against both attack classes in the related-key model.

citations.label: Structural Evaluation of AES and Chosen-Key Distinguisher of 9-Round AES-128

progress.summary: The paper's conclusion explicitly lists obtaining this formal related-key security proof as a future task and presents it as unresolved.
citation_labels: Pierre-Alain Fouque et al., Structural Evaluation of AES and Chosen-Key Distinguisher of 9-Round AES-128
